prompt_text: What are the best online courses for learning shadow work and spiritual practice?

answer_verbatim:
If you want the **best online courses** for *shadow work plus spiritual practice*, the strongest options in your results are **Awake Academy**, **Jung Platform**, **ManTalks**, and a few focused Udemy courses that combine shadow work with meditation, prayers, or self-inquiry.[6][16][18][5]

A practical way to choose is:

- **Most spiritually integrated:** **Awake Academy** — combines shadow work with mindfulness, Western psychology, insight training, and Tibetan Buddhism.[6]
- **Most Jungian / depth-psychology focused:** **Jung Platform** — offers an introduction to Jungian shadow work and a broader shadow-courses collection aimed at depth and authenticity.[4][15][16]
- **Most guided and structured for self-discovery:** **ManTalks Shadow Course** — an 8-week guided process for facing and integrating the shadow.[18][2]
- **Most explicitly spiritual practice-oriented on Udemy:** **Shadow Work Course and Workbook** — includes lessons, exercises, diagrams, meditations, prayers, and practices for spiritual transformation.[5]
- **Best beginner-friendly workbook-style option:** **Shadow Work: A Beginner’s Guide to Self-Healing** or **Shadow Work Essentials** on Udemy, both centered on practical techniques for working with hidden parts of the psyche.[10][9]

A quick comparison:

| Course | Best for | Why it stands out |
|---|---|---|
| Awake Academy course directory | Integrated spiritual practice | Blends shadow work with mindfulness, psychology, insight training, and Tibetan Buddhism.[6] |
| Jung Platform shadow courses | Jungian shadow work | Depth-psychology framing, with courses specifically about recognizing shadow patterns and living with greater authenticity.[4][16] |
| ManTalks Shadow Course | Structured guided journey | An 8-week process focused on fully facing and integrating the shadow.[18] |
| Udemy: Shadow Work Course and Workbook | Spiritual transformation | Includes meditations, prayers, and practices alongside shadow-work exercises.[5] |
| Udemy: Shadow Work: A Beginner’s Guide to Self-Healing | Beginners | Focuses on self-healing and accessible techniques.[10] |

If you want the **single best pick** for “shadow work + spiritual practice,” **Awake Academy** is the closest match in your results because it explicitly combines shadow work with mindfulness and Tibetan Buddhism.[6] If you want a more **psychological/Jungian** path, **Jung Platform** is the stronger choice.[4][16]
